Name: Fishing Overhaul
Author: Raven7s
Description:
[b][size=6]Description[/size][/b]

[center][color=#ffffff][size=5][font=Arial]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/kanna2018/mods]kanna2018[/url] for creating the compatibility beautification of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50370]Cat Valley Compatibility For Fishing Overhaul[/url] ！[/font][/size][/color][/center]

[size=4][b]Fishing Overhaul Mod[/b] completely reimagines Stardew Valley's fishing into a action-packed tension system (inspired by games like RDR2). Core gameplay focuses on managing line tension and timing your reel.[/size]

[size=4][size=4]It provides extensive configuration options. If you find the gameplay too hard or too easy, you can highly customize various multiplier values via the config menu.[/size][/size]

[size=4][b]100% Save Safe:[/b] Can be added mid-playthrough! This mod does not alter your save files or add new item IDs. You can safely install or uninstall it at any time without corrupting your current game. [/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50033/50033-1785598026-1585347414.png[/img]
[line]
[b][size=6]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install the latest version of[/size][b][size=4] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/size][/b][/*]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#ff7700]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/url] [b]（Highly recommended for customizing settings）[/b].[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and unzip the  [u]FishingOverhaulMod[/u]   folder into your   [u]Stardew Valley/Mods[/u]   folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=6]Main features[/size][/b]

[b][size=5]I. Core Mechanics Changes[/size] [/b]
[b][size=4]1. Fishing Level In this mod, your fishing level directly determines: [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]Base Reel Speed: Each level grants additional base pulling power (configurable). [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Quality Guarantee: Retains vanilla logic perfectly. Level 4 guarantees Silver star, Level 8 guarantees Gold star. [/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]2. Tackle & Bait [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]Cork Bobber: [Vanilla] Increases green bar size -> [Mod] Grants additional reel speed. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Trap Bobber: [Vanilla] Slows fish escape -> [Mod] Reduces tension increase rate by 30%. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Lead Bobber: [Vanilla] Prevents bouncing at the bottom -> [Mod] When you release the line, the progress bar drain caused by the fish escaping drops to 0. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Quality Bobber: Retains vanilla logic. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Fishing Poles: Retains vanilla logic. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Bait: Fully compatible with vanilla advanced bait logic. [/size]
Wild Bait: Still has a chance to catch two fish at once (affected by Luck). Challenge Bait: Still yields three fish upon a "Perfect" catch. [/*]
[/list][b][size=4]3. Quality Calculation & "Perfect" Catches [/size][/b]
[size=4]Fish quality is determined by a combination of your fishing level and mechanical execution: [/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Base Quality: Levels 0-3 = Normal, Levels 4-7 = Silver, Level 8+ guarantees Gold. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Quality Upgrades: A "Perfect" catch guarantees a one-tier upgrade (up to Iridium). Using a Quality Bobber adds another tier. [/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]"Perfect" Catch Conditions (Both must be met):[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][b]Tolerance:[/b] By default, if your highest progress point drops by more than 20 points (configurable), you lose the "Perfect" rating. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Time Limit:[/b] If the struggle lasts longer than [/size]

[code]12 seconds + (Fish Difficulty / 5)[/code][size=4], the fish will lose its perfect quality due to exhaustion from struggling. [/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]4. Fish Movement AI Adjustments[/b] [/size]
[size=4]The four vanilla movement types have been rebalanced with the following values: [/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Dart:[/b] Extremely short idle and struggle times. Tension builds up very quickly (1.2x tension accumulation). [/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Smooth:[/b] Long idle times, but struggles last longer once they start. Tension builds up slower (0.7x). [/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Sinker:[/b] The progress bar drops extremely fast when the player releases the line. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Floater:[/b] The player receives an additional bonus to reel speed.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4](Note: Legendary fish are tagged separately and will display a crown icon when hooked.) [/size]




[b][size=5]II. New Mod Mechanics[/size] [/b]
[b][size=4]1. Stamina & Fatigue System[/size] [/b]
[size=4]As the fishing time increases, the fish's stamina will gradually deplete: [/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Standard Fish: After struggling for 50 seconds, stamina drops to 35%. [/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Legendary Fish: Takes 75 seconds to become fatigued, and retains at least 55% stamina even when exhausted. [/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]2. Reel Speed Formula[/b] [/size]
[size=4]The final reel speed is calculated as follows: [/size]
[code](Base 22 + Fishing Level * 0.8 + Tackle/Behavior Bonus) * Player Config Multiplier[/code]


[size=4][b]Q: Is this compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Ridgeside Village (RSV), or other custom fish mods?[/b] [/size]
[size=4][b]A: 100% YES![/b] This mod dynamically reads the game's master data dictionary. Any custom fish added by other mods will automatically work. The custom fish's specific "Difficulty" will translate into its tension strength, and its "Behavior" (Dart, Smooth, Sinker, Floater) will seamlessly trigger the corresponding combat AI in this mod.[/size]
